verdict.rationale: Temporal documents Queries and message handlers for reading state from a running workflow. These are general primitives a developer could use to poll for progress. The pack has no documented capability for streaming step updates or model tokens from a running workflow into a frontend. Building blocks earn no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I stream live progress — step updates or model tokens — from a running workflow into my frontend as it executes
